description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Deceptive Frostkite dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Deceptive Frostkite enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Deceptive Frostkite leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Deceptive Frostkite from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
